highlights.reason_zh: Cloudflare 确认 155 条 GLM-5.3 响应跨租户泄露数据，问题直指分离式推理的 KV cache 隔离和验收方法。
highlights.reason_en: Cloudflare confirms 155 GLM-5.3 responses leaked cross-tenant data, exposing a concrete acceptance gap in disaggregated KV-cache isolation.

highlights.reason_zh: GPT-6.1 Terra 已在 API、ChatGPT Work 与 Codex GA，把 computer use 的标准 token 价格降到 Sol 的一半。
highlights.reason_en: GPT-6.1 Terra is GA in the API, ChatGPT Work and Codex, halving standard token prices versus Sol for computer-use routing.

highlights.reason_zh: Unlimited-OCR-2 已公开 MIT 权重和可运行路径，直接关系长文档 RAG 的切页、显存与跨页上下文取舍。
highlights.reason_en: Unlimited-OCR-2 ships MIT-licensed weights and runnable paths, directly affecting page splitting, memory and cross-page context in document RAG.

highlights.reason_zh: Qwen Code 0.26.2 同时改动 managed 权限、token 注入防护与恢复链路，直接影响长时 coding agent 的验收范围。
highlights.reason_en: Qwen Code 0.26.2 changes managed permissions, token-injection defenses and recovery paths, directly expanding long-running-agent acceptance tests.

highlights.reason_zh: Claude Code 修复压缩后旧 memory、重启后重复 skill 与后台 worktree 生命周期问题，都是会悄悄污染结果的故障。
highlights.reason_en: Claude Code fixes stale post-compaction memory, duplicate restarted skills and background-worktree lifecycle failures that can silently corrupt outcomes.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并完成阅读，并补查官方博客、API changelog、GitHub、arXiv、开源仓库、中文线索、可靠媒体和重大综合新闻。召回自检补获 Cloudflare 的 KV cache 事故与 Unlimited-OCR-2 开放权重；后者的仓库创建和文件上传时间可核验，但发布列表只有日期。Terra 与 OpenAI 数学更新也是上一快照未出现的补漏；研究与厂商性能尚未独立复现，Cohere 的 Qwen3.8 安全主张暂缓。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read, supplemented by official blogs, API changelogs, GitHub, arXiv, open-source repositories, Chinese-language leads, reliable media and major general news. The recall audit recovered Cloudflare’s KV-cache incident and Unlimited-OCR-2 open weights; repository creation and uploads have exact timestamps, while the release list gives only a date. Terra and the OpenAI math update were also absent from the prior capture. Research and vendor performance remain independently unverified, and Cohere’s Qwen3.8 safety claim is deferred.
